headline: Public facilities tour of six schools and the SAU10 Administrative Office.
summary: The tour visits six school buildings and the SAU10 Administrative Office. Transportation between sites will not be provided.
items: Facilities tour of South Range Elementary, Gilbert H. Hood Middle, Grinnell Elementary, Ernest P. Barka Elementary, SAU10 Administrative Office, West Running Brook Intermediate, and East Derry Memorial Elementary
